programme.title: Sunīte Blūija
programme.desc: Blūija ir mīlīga, kustīga un enerģiska sešgadīga sunīte, kura dzīvo kopā ar savu mammu, tēti un četrus gadus veco mazo māsiņu Bingo. Blūijai patīk spēlēties un katru ierasto ģimenes dienu pārvērst piedzīvojumos. Rotaļās un spēlēs attīstās sunītes iztēle un pasaules uztvere.

programme.title: 15. Saeimas vēlēšanas. Rīta Panorāmas speciālizlaidums
programme.desc: 15. Saeimas vēlēšanas. Rīta Panorāmas speciālizlaidums.

programme.title: Izsijāju, izdancoju. TDA Zelta sietiņš 60 gadu jubilejas koncerts
programme.desc: Leģendārais bērnu deju kolektīvs "Zelta sietiņš" savas 60 gadu jubilejas svinības ar grandiozu koncertu "Izsijāju, izdancoju" noslēdza Dailes teātrī. Šajos 60 gados šī kolektīva "skolu" izgājuši ap 10 000 dejotāju, tostarp sabiedrībā pazīstami cilvēki – viņu vidū arī Laura Groza-Ķibere, Nora Ikstena, Aigars Grauba un citi. Jubilejas trešajā koncertā " izSIJĀJU, izDANCOJU" tika izdejota daļa no ansambļa deju "dimanta fonda".

programme.title: Alana Tičmārša dārznieku klubiņš
programme.desc: Alans Tičmāršs noslēdz sava dārznieku klubiņa otro sezonu. Klēra Laurija stāsta, kā sagatavot telpaugus vasarai un palīdzēt tiem veiksmīgi pārciest gada siltāko laiku. Kamila Baseta-Smita apmeklē iespaidīgu Devonas piekrastes dārzu, bet Keitija Votsone pēdējo reizi šajā sezonā aicina skatītājus savā Hempšīras dārzā, lai parādītu augus, kas labi panes gan ilgstošu lietu, gan sausumu. Savukārt Džovanna Flečere atbild uz pieciem jautājumiem par dārzkopību, daloties savās atmiņās, iecienītākajos paņēmienos un gūtajā pieredzē.

programme.title: Lielās patiesības
programme.desc: "Lielās patiesības" rudens sezonā LTV ēterā atgriežas ar jaunu raidījumu ciklu "Vecā Derība mūsdienu cilvēkam". Mūsdienu cilvēks ikdienā gana bieži sastopas ar Vecās Derības stāstiem un personālijām. Piemēram, piesaucot grēku plūdus vai Kainu un Ābelu. Vecās Derības motīvi daudz atrodami gan klasiskās, gan modernās kultūras darbos. Šajos darbos atklājam cilvēku dzīves eksistenciālos jautājumus, kas joprojām ir aktuāli arī mūsdienu cilvēkam - mīlestība, naids, nodevība. "Lielo patiesību" veidotāji 12 sēriju ciklā atgādinās Vecās Derības atsevišķus spilgtākos motīvus un tēlus, lai sarunās ar dažādiem cilvēkiem rosinātu pārdomas par mūsdienu dzīves eksistenciālajiem jautājumiem. Būs pārdomas par radīšanas stāstu, par pirmatnējo grēku, par Kainu un Ābelu, par grēku plūdiem, par 40 gadiem tuksnesī, par Ījābu. Būtībā tie visi būs stāsti par mūsdienu cilvēku. Raidījuma vadītājam Ilmāram Latkovskim šajā ciklā ar komentāriem un intriģējošiem jautājumiem pievienosies vēsturnieks, skolotājs un mūziķis Mikus Solovejs. Paredzama arī jauniešu iesaistīšanās ar tiešu un skaidru valodu.

programme.title: Krustpunktā
programme.desc: Visvairāk klausītais Latvijas radio raidījums "Krustpunktā" redzams arī Latvijas televīzijas ēterā. Ne tiešraidē, bet ar nelielu nobīdi, iespējams sekot līdzi gan aktuālajām intervijām, gan klausītāju uzdotajiem jautājumiem un amatpersonu atbildēm.

programme.title: Labākie gadi
programme.desc: Ģimene dodas ceļā uz atrakciju parku, taču viņu plānus pēkšņi maina zvans no Luīses mammas. Luīses vecāmāte ir slimnīcā, un tuvojas viņas dzīves pēdējās stundas. Visa ģimene sapulcējas slimnīcā, lai atvadītos. Kamēr Matīass mēģina izmantot iespēju, lai izskaidrotu Svenam, kas ir nāve, Luīses ģimene cīnās ne tikai ar emocijām, bet arī mantojuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Austras balva pasniegšanas ceremonija
programme.desc: Septembrī jau devīto reizi tika pasniegta "Austras balva", izceļot labāko divpadsmit mēnešu periodā Latvijas mūziķu izdoto neakadēmiskās mūzikas albumu plašas mūzikas pazinēju žūrijas vērtējumā. Šī gada "Austras balvas" nominantu koncertā uzstājās ansis, "Carnival Youth", "Elpo", "Juuk", "Les Attitudes Spectrales", Saule-Saule" un "Tribes of the City", savukārt koncerta noslēgumā tika paziņots šī gada uzvarētājs.

programme.title: Brīvības bulvāris
programme.desc: Iespējams, ka tā ir liktenīga nejaušība, ka Rīgā ir dzimis viens no 20. gadsimta lielākajiem brīvības filozofiem Jesaja Berlins, kura domas un idejas par brīvību noteica 20. gadsimta filozofisko domāšanu. Berlins bija tas, kurš aicināja brīvību nejaukt ar laimi vai kaut ko citu un kurš cita starpā ir teicis, ka totalitāra vara vispirms iznīcina pirmos brīvas apziņas un ideju cilvēkus. Raidījums "Brīvības bulvāris" reizi nedēļā piedāvā tikšanās un sarunas ar cilvēkiem, kuru domas un idejas varbūt liek mums pašiem kļūt gudrākiem.

programme.title: Kultūrdeva
programme.desc: Pirmo reizi "Kultūrdevā" viesojas Latvijas Nacionālā mākslas muzeja direktore Iveta Derkusova, kura šo amatu ieņem četrus mēnešus, kļūstot par Māras Lāces pēcteci. Iveta Derkusova mākslas muzeja dažādās struktūrās strādā jau 31 gadu un katru darba dienas rītu cenšas iesākt, vienatnē izejot caur muzeja ekspozīcijām. Raidījuma otrajā daļā runāsim ar gudrajiem un daudzsološajiem, kuri savus pirmos radošos darbus šogad izrādīs Latvijas Kultūras akadēmijas skatuves un audiovizuālās mākslas festivālā "Patriarha rudens". Mūsu viesi būs jaunais dramaturgs un režisors Gusts Ābele, kā arī psihologs un kinorežisors Edgars Haritončenko.

programme.title: Dienas ziņas
programme.desc: Jau pulksten 18:00 svarīgākais par aktuālajiem notikumiem Latvijā un pasaulē – uzticamas, objektīvas un daudzpusīgas ziņas! Raidījumā skatāmas arī novadu ziņas – par jaunākajiem notikumiem Kurzemē, Vidzemē, Latgalē un Zemgalē vēsta Latvijas reģionālo televīziju korespondenti. Raidījumu vada Ilze Vēbere, Ilze Dobele, Jānis Geste, Laura Vonda.

programme.title: Sporta ziņas
programme.desc: Katru dienu pēc "Panorāmas".

programme.title: Laika ziņas
programme.desc: Jaunākie laika apstākļi un precīzākās prognozes Latvijai un Eiropai, ziņas par interesantām dabas parādībām un brīdinājumi par īpaši vērā ņemamiem hidrometeoroloģiskajiem apstākļiem. Vadītāji: Toms Bricis, Ilze Skudra, Ramona Salmiņa.

programme.title: Diskusija par 15. Saeimas vēlēšanu rezultātiem
programme.desc: Kuri politiskie spēki svinējuši uzvaru un kuriem nācies piedzīvot vilšanos? Kā izskatīsies jaunais parlamenta sasaukums, kā arī - kādas būs reālākās aprises nākamajai valdības koalīcijai un valsts turpmākajam kursam? Diskusija ar partiju līderiem.

programme.title: Panorāma
programme.desc: Latvijā vecākā informatīvā programma "Panorāma", kas ēterā ir kopš 1958. gada, šo gadu laikā pulcējusi vairākus simtus darbinieku. Šodien "Panorāmas" veidošanā iesaistās gandrīz viss Latvijas televīzijas Ziņu dienests. "Panorāma" neapšaubāmi ir mediju ikona Latvijā un daudz kas vairāk par vienkāršu ziņu raidījumu. "Panorāma" ir Atmodas lieciniece un veicinātāja. Ar šo raidījumu uzaugušas vairākas paaudzes, kurām "Panorāmas" skatīšanās ir nesatricināms ikvakara rituāls.

programme.title: Sporta ziņas
programme.desc: Katru dienu pēc "Panorāmas".

programme.title: Laika ziņas
programme.desc: Jaunākie laika apstākļi un precīzākās prognozes Latvijai un Eiropai, ziņas par interesantām dabas parādībām un brīdinājumi par īpaši vērā ņemamiem hidrometeoroloģiskajiem apstākļiem. Vadītāji: Toms Bricis, Ilze Skudra, Ramona Salmiņa.

programme.title: Broukenvuda
programme.desc: Jaunzēlandes mazpilsētā Broukenvudā inspektors Maiks Šeperds vada policijas iecirkni un brīvajā laikā pievēršas vīna ražošanai. Vietējie iedzīvotāji pazīst cits citu, un, lai gan sabiedrība šķiet saliedēta, to veido visai kolorīti indivīdi. Atkal un atkal pilsētiņas mierīgo dzīvi pārtrauc kāds savāds notikums vai baiss noziegums, un inspektoram Šeperdam kopā ar saviem palīgiem detektīvi Kristenu Simsu un konsteblu Čalmersu ir jāievieš skaidrība un jāsauc pie atbildības vainīgie.

programme.title: Nelūgtie viesi
programme.desc: Ralfs iznāk no cietuma un atgriežas Kandavā. Rasma cenšas savaldzināt Uģi. Ričards pārsteidz visus ar pārsteidzošu priekšnesumu.

programme.title: Tu man neko neatgādini
programme.desc: Intīms stāsts par mīlestību, kurā ikviens kaut nedaudz atpazīs sevi un visu filmu domās, vai šīs attiecības vispār ir iespējamas Mūsdienu dejas māksliniece Elena iepazīstas ar zīmju valodas tulku Dāvīdu. Starp viņiem acumirklī izveidojas saikne, tā kļūst arvien dziļāka. Dāvīds un Elena satuvinās, un platoniskās attiecības pamazām kļūst par romantiskām. Kad Dāvīds atzīstas, ka ir aseksuāls, viņi nolemj savu intimitāti meklēt kopā - atrast pašiem savu veidu uz tuvību Filmas pasaules pirmizrāde notika prestižajā Sandānsas (ASV) kinofestivālā, kurā tā ieguva balvu par labāko režijas darbu. Tāpat filma ieguvusi arī Lietuvas nacionālo balvu "Sudraba dzērve" labākajai aktrisei un labākajam aktierim.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Vītolu iela Liepājā gandrīz pilnībā tika nopostīta Otrā pasaules kara pirmajās dienās. Neskartas palika vien dažas villas tajā ielas posmā, kas tagad pārdēvēts Ēvalda Rimbenieka vārdā. Kāpēc tā notika? Liepājniekiem uz mēles ir dažādas versijas, bet īsto atbildi vēsturnieki meklē joprojām. Pēckara Vītolu iela ieguva pilnīgi citu veidolu – tur uzcēla padomju "kastīšu" tipa mājas, bet pašlaik esam liecinieki grandiozām pārmaiņām, jo top jauns kvartāls ar intriģējošu nosaukumu "Oāze" Savā gājumā Vītolu iela satiekas ar Bērzu aleju, kura laikmeta griežos aizmirsta un pamesta novārtā, bet kas zina – varbūt uzplauks no jauna?

programme.title: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma
programme.desc: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma ir sirsnīgi muzikāls raidījums, kurā tiek atspoguļotas tautā vispopulārākās latviešu mūzikas dzīves norises šī vārda visplašākajā nozīmē.

programme.title: Dziesmas ceļš. Jānim Peteram –
programme.desc: Ir vai nav veltījums Maestro sunim Raimonda Paula un Jāņa Petera "Mēmā dziesma"? Centīsimies noskaidrot, kam un kā tapa 1976. gadā dzimusī "Mēmā dziesma" jeb "Tava balss". Dziesma skanējusi Sopotas Starptautiskajā dziesmu festivālā 1976. gadā. Tā ir arī visvairāk godalgu un simpātiju saņēmusī Paula / Petera dziesma. Dziesmas ceļu šķetinās Raimonds Pauls, Jānis Peters, Viktors Lapčenoks, Zigfrīds Muktupāvels un Andris Keišs.

programme.title: Meža stāsti
programme.desc: Televīzijas režisora un žurnālista Armanda Tripāna veidotais raidījums "Meža stāsti" ir stāsts par Latvijas "plaušām" – mežiem. Par cilvēkiem, kuri savu dzīvi ir saistījuši ar "dabas māti". Seši stāstnieki, seši dabas procesi, seši dzīvesstāsti un viens vienojošais faktors – māte daba. "Meža stāstu" komanda ir bijusi Latvijas nomaļākajos mežu biezokņos – Zvārdas, Ļaudonas, Aizkraukles, Madonas un citos mežu masīvos. Šis būs skaists ceļojums ar operatora Artūra Liepiņa kameras aci, kas ļaus ieraudzīt un sajust mežu burvību jau ar pirmajiem saullēktiem. Raidījuma galvenais virzītājspēks ir stāstnieks – cilvēks, kurš savu arodu ir savienojis ar mežu. Galvenais raidījuma mērķis bija izprast cilvēkus, kas savu mūža darbu ir veltījuši mežam. Dokumentālā raidījuma forma ļaus būt blakus stāstnieka ikdienas ritmam. Skatītājiem būs iespēja doties līdzi stāstniekiem Latvijas nomaļākajos, biezākajos un skaistākajos mežos.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Pirmdienas vakars atvēlēts erudīcijai, prāta apcirkņu izvēdināšanai, labam azartam un jaunām zināšanām. Spēlēs komandas, kuru kapteines ir Beate Bergsone un Zane Vaļule. Beate Bergsone - komandas kapteine. Darbojas viesmīlības pasaulē. Studējusi žurnālistiku un personāla psiholoģiju, aizrāvusies ar runas mākslu, erudīcijas spēlēm un vīnu pasauli. Beatei patīk izaicināt savu prātu un uzticēties intuīcijai, viens no viņas sapņiem ir reiz ierunāt kādu multfilmas vai pasaku tēlu. Leina Markevica - vienkārši brīvmāksliniece, viegli pierunājama spontāniem plāniem un piedzīvojumiem, aizraujas ar improvizāciju un komēdiju. Patīk radīt apkārtējiem patīkamu noskaņojumu, prot neapjukt neparedzētās situācijās pat tad, kad nekas nenotiek pēc plāna, tāpēc draugi uztic svarīgu pasākumu organizēšanu tieši viņai. Olafs Arnicāns - strādā tehnoloģiju nozarē, kur jaunu informāciju apgūst ātri un ar vieglumu, brīvajā laikā lasa un skatās dokumentālās filmas. Patiesu dvēseles piepildījumu Olafs rod, dodoties dabā vai aktīvi sportojot. Viņš zina labākās sēņu vietas, taču šo vērtīgo informāciju rūpīgi glabā. Mīl arī eksperimentēt virtuvē. Zane Vaļule - komandas kapteine. No Augšdaugavas novada, kur strādā par Latgales zooloģiskā dārza ekskursiju vadītāju. 22 gadus pavadījusi skolas un universitātes solos, bet nu izbauda dienas bez mājasdarbiem. Piecus mēnešus dzīvojusi Kanādā, vairāk nekā gadu - automašīnā Jaunzēlandē. Ļoti patīk pārvietoties kājām un laimēt loterijās. Aivis Vaļulis - kapteines brālis. Strādā meliorācijas nozarē Jelgavas pusē. Domā tik ātri, ka pats reizēm netiek līdzi savam domu gājienam. Ievērības cienīgs fakts - sešas reizes pieveicis pārgājienu Kolka–Dubulti. Televīzijas raidījumus neskatās, bet pats tajos reizēm piedalās. Liene Lubāne – no Jēkabpils, studējusi vides zinātnes, šobrīd strādā privātā uzņēmumā, kas gatavo bērnu rotaļu laukumus. Liene ir kapteines draudzene, brīvajā laikā strādā savā lauku saimniecībā, iet pārgājienos un izlīdz draugiem, kas iesprūduši vētras izraisītos postījumos un netiek uz "V.I.P." ierakstu, tā pati kļūstot no līdzjutējas par dalībnieci.

programme.title: Personība. 100 g kultūras
programme.desc: Gan mūzikas notikumu tiešraides, gan raidījumi un diskusijas par literatūru, kino, vizuālo un tautas mākslu, gan populāro kultūru, kas attīsta latvisko identitāti.

programme.title: Aizliegtais paņēmiens
programme.desc: Lai uzzinātu par kāda notikuma patiesajiem apstākļiem vai iesaistīto personu nodomiem, raidījuma "Aizliegtais paņēmiens" komanda informācijas iegūšanai izmanto visdažādākos izmeklējošās žurnālistikas paņēmienus un žanrus – eksperimentus, testus, provokācijas, padziļinātus pētījumus, arī anonīmas intervijas. Žurnālisti padziļināti pēta un skatītājiem atklāj sociālpolitiskus tematus, kas ne vienmēr tiek izcelti citos medijos. Raidījums atklāj un atmasko, atsevišķos gadījumos sauc pie atbildības iesaistītās personas, norāda uz likumu nepilnībām, aicina mainīt pastāvošo kārtību, ja tā ir pretrunā sabiedrības interesēm. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta žurnālists Guntis Bojārs.

programme.title: Personība. 100 g kultūras
programme.desc: Gan mūzikas notikumu tiešraides, gan raidījumi un diskusijas par literatūru, kino, vizuālo un tautas mākslu, gan populāro kultūru, kas attīsta latvisko identitāti.

programme.title: Bahs pret Covid
programme.desc: Normunds pandēmijas depresiju pārvar, spēlējot čellu Vecrīgā. Viņa brīvdabas skatuve ir gandrīz tukša. Čellists, baloži un policijas patruļas ir gandrīz vienīgās dzīvās dvēseles Doma laukumā. Normundam negribas iet mājās, jo meita un sieva ir viņu nokaitinājušas. Pēc 27 gadu kopdzīves viņš palicis viens ar savu meiteni – čellu ar slaido vidukli. "Covid-19" pandēmija bija pārbaudījums planētai Zeme un tās iemītniekiem. Miljoniem cilvēku visos kontinentos slimoja un mira. Protesti, potes, tuvinieku nāve un nodevība ierāva mūs pandēmijas pārvarēšanas karuselī, bet katrs no mums savu pandēmiju pārdzīvoja viens.

programme.title: Pārtikas revidents
programme.desc: "Pārtikas revidents" ir analītisks raidījums, kas pēta veikalu plauktos un tirgū pieejamās pārtikas izcelsmi, saturu un cenu atšķirību, katrā raidījumā īpašu uzmanību veltot kādam produktam. Kas patiesībā ir šī produkta sastāvā? Kas ir izplatītākie mīti par to, un vai tie ir patiesi? Kur un kā šis pārtikas produkts tiek radīts? Vai cena vienmēr nozīmē kvalitāti? Šie ir tikai daži no jautājumiem, uz kuriem tiek meklētas atbildes. Raidījuma idejas autors ir žurnālists un raidījuma "Aizliegtais Paņēmiens" vadītājs Guntis Bojārs, vadītāja – Ieva Strazdiņa. Tā vienlaikus ir arī Ievas Strazdiņas debija LTV žurnālistu komandā. Raidījumā aktīvi darbosies arī žurnālistes Krista Tuča, Lauma Krastiņa un Liena Skadiņa.

programme.title: Pārtikas revidents
programme.desc: "Pārtikas revidents" ir analītisks raidījums, kas pēta veikalu plauktos un tirgū pieejamās pārtikas izcelsmi, saturu un cenu atšķirību, katrā raidījumā īpašu uzmanību veltot kādam produktam. programme.title: Lielās patiesības
programme.desc: Sākoties jaunajai rudens sezonai, "Lielās patiesības" atskatās uz vasaras saulgriežiem, laiku, kad saule gada ritumā sasniedz savu augstāko punktu un sāk ceļu pretī nākamajiem saulgriežiem. Kamēr dienas kļūst īsākas un daba pamazām gatavojas citam gadalaikam, atgriežamies pie Jāņu laika sarunas par nemitīgo mainību dabā un cilvēkā. Vasaras saulgriežos "Lielās patiesības" Alūksnē ciemojās pie koktēlnieka un radoša cilvēka Harija Stradiņa. Saruna par ieradumiem, kurus neapzināti mantojam no saviem senčiem un atkārtojam no paaudzes paaudzē. Daba un koki mums rāda, kas ar mums noticis, kas notiek un kas vēl tikai būs. Harijs stāsta, kā, strādājot ar koku, cilvēks labāk izzina pats sevi: savu prātu, sajūtas un ķermeni. Līdztekus koka skaņām Harijs iepazīstina arī ar sena ārstniecības un mūzikas instrumenta vargāna metāliskajām vibrācijām.

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: Kultūrdeva
programme.desc: Raidījumā "Kultūrdeva" viesosies māksliniece Frančeska Kirke, ar kuru kopā atzīmēsim viņas tēva mākslinieka Gunāra Kirkes 100 gadu jubileju, kā arī neparastu mūzikas festivālu rīkotāji – Armands Siliņš-Bergmanis no Sansusī festivāla un Rihards Endriksons no festivāla "Skaņu mežs".

programme.title: 1:1. Aktuālā intervija
programme.desc: Raidījumā "1:1" [viens pret vienu] satiekas sabiedrībā zināma personība un žurnālists. Raidījums skaidro, analizē un ļauj izprast sabiedrībai nozīmīgas norises visdažādākajās dzīves jomās Latvijā un pasaulē, izprast personības nozīmīgumu, atbildību šo procesu virzībā. Viesi izvēlēti, ņemot vērā tā brīža aktualitātes vai arī konkrētās personas iespējamo ietekmi uz notikumiem nākotnē, – valsts pirmās amatpersonas, biznesa, kultūras un nevalstiskā sektora pārstāvji. Raidījumu vada žurnālists Gundars Rēders.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: Ļūmaņu ģimene Vecumniekos ir ienācēji, lai gan pēc divdesmit šeit nodzīvotiem gadiem vietējie jau sen viņus uzskata par savējiem, riktīgi savējiem. Tur pie vainas varbūt ir arī tas, ka viņiem nav vienaldzīgi, kā dzīvo līdzcilvēki. Ar mērķi palīdzēt vietējai kopienai savulaik tapa "Ļūmaņu ģimenes fonds". Tā, pateicoties fonda darbībai, Vecumnieki tika pie daudzfunkcionāla sporta laukuma un vietējā mūzikas skola - pie jauna flīģeļa. Vēl viņi prot apvienot vietējos ļaudis gan talkās, gan sporta spēlēs, gan vācot ziedojumus. Kad sākās karš Ukrainā, Ļūmaņu ģimene uzskatīja, ka sēdēt malā un vienkārši visā tanī noraudzīties būtu noziedzīgi. Tāpēc šoruden uz Ukrainu devās kārtējais fonda organizētais konvojs.

programme.title: Aculiecinieks
programme.desc: 13 minūšu gari televīzijas stāsti vēsta par notikumiem un Latvijā īpašiem cilvēkiem, aptverot vēsturiskus, zinātnes, izglītības, pilsētas, lauku un daudzus citus tematus.

programme.title: Amatieris
programme.desc: Profesija ir kas vairāk par darbību un amata nosaukumu, zem tās ir personība. Šajās sērijās raidījuma vadītājs Reinis Ošenieks izmēģinās un kļūs par amatieri visdažādākajās nodarbēs. Sākot ar netradicionāliem hobijiem līdz profesijām, par kurām tiek runāts reti. Raidījuma vadītājam vienmēr būs kāds līdzgaitnieks, sabiedrībā zināms cilvēks, kurš kopā ar vadītāju centīsies dienas laikā kļūt no iesācēja par amatieri. Humors tiks sabalansēts ar informatīvām sadaļām un interesantām personībām. Intriga par izzināmo profesiju saglabāsies līdz pēdējam brīdim, jo raidījuma viesis nezinās, kas viņu dienas laikā sagaidīs.

programme.title: Salas – savvaļas laboratorijas
programme.desc: Salas ir evolūcijas eksperimentu laboratorijas: dzīvība izolētā teritorijā ir spiesta pielāgoties unikāliem dabas likumiem. Biotopi - kalni, saldūdens un meži - ir cieši saistīti ar jūru. Visiem dzīvniekiem - no mazākā līdz lielākajam - jāatrod veids, kā iekļauties šajā unikālajā, izolētajā vidē. Daži augi un dzīvnieki mutācijas ceļā kļūst par milžiem, citi - par punduriem. Šajās dokumentālajās sērijās aplūkotas sešu pasaules salu unikālās ekosistēmas, ar modernu tehnoloģiju palīdzību ielūkojoties salu dzīvē, kas cilvēka acij citkārt paliktu apslēpta.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Pirmās lēdijas
programme.desc: Tradicionāli pirmajai lēdijai bija jāpilda sociālā un saimnieces loma. Taču Elenora bija žurnāliste un sociālā aktīviste, kas iestājās par cilvēktiesībām un pret rasu segregāciju. Viņa netaisījās to visu pamest, lai Baltajā namā pasniegtu tēju un izvēlētos jaunu servīzi. Elenora izmantoja radio un presi, lai komunicētu ar cilvēkiem. Var teikt, ka viņa bija pirmā blogere.

programme.title: Markoviča metode
programme.desc: Pēc smaga nozieguma izdarīšanas Roberts Smrks tiek nosūtīts uz piespiedu ārstēšanos. Pēc diviem gadiem viņš iznāk brīvībā un apgalvo, ka ir vesels. Tas raisa spraigu diskusiju starp Markoviču un viņa draugu psihiatru Petru Ržemenu. Prāgas Motolas mikrorajonā tiek izvarota un nogalināta sieviete. Izmeklēšanu uztic Markoviča grupai.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Niks ierodas pie Veronikas un paziņo, ka kāds viņu cenšas iegāzt. Vēlāk viņš aicina Stefanu uz tikšanos, piedāvājot informāciju. Patriks izjautā Rafaelu par pornogrāfiskajām filmām, kurās puisis piedalījies, un uzzina vērtīgus pavedienus, kas izmeklētājiem jāpārbauda.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Komanda uzzina, ka Klāras volejbola skolotājs Paskalēns Perons ir visu zinājis par jauniešu filmām, bet klusējis. Viņš tiek nopratināts. Tikmēr Nansija priecājas par savu jauno dzīvi - saņemtais naudas žūksnis no bijušā un gaidāmais bērns no Bruno ir iemesls nosvinēt kopā ar māsu, kura vēl šaubās un nespēj noticēt, ka māsa ir stāvoklī no Bruno.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Policija ierodas pornogrāfijas filmēšanas vietā un arestē astoņus nepilngadīgus jauniešus, kā arī trīs pilngadīgos - filmēšanas komandu. Filmu režisors Marks izstāsta par filmēšanas procesu, taču pasūtītāju viņš nevar atklāt. Gabriela liek kolēģiem pasargāt ziņotājus - Rafaelu un Maju, kura Floransai atklāj daļu taisnības par filmēšanu.

programme.title: Bahs pret Covid
programme.desc: Normunds pandēmijas depresiju pārvar, spēlējot čellu Vecrīgā. Viņa brīvdabas skatuve ir gandrīz tukša. Čellists, baloži un policijas patruļas ir gandrīz vienīgās dzīvās dvēseles Doma laukumā. Normundam negribas iet mājās, jo meita un sieva ir viņu nokaitinājušas. Pēc 27 gadu kopdzīves viņš palicis viens ar savu meiteni – čellu ar slaido vidukli. "Covid-19" pandēmija bija pārbaudījums planētai Zeme un tās iemītniekiem. Miljoniem cilvēku visos kontinentos slimoja un mira. Protesti, potes, tuvinieku nāve un nodevība ierāva mūs pandēmijas pārvarēšanas karuselī, bet katrs no mums savu pandēmiju pārdzīvoja viens.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Pirmdienas vakars atvēlēts erudīcijai, prāta apcirkņu izvēdināšanai, labam azartam un jaunām zināšanām. Spēlēs komandas, kuru kapteines ir Beate Bergsone un Zane Vaļule. Beate Bergsone - komandas kapteine. Darbojas viesmīlības pasaulē. Studējusi žurnālistiku un personāla psiholoģiju, aizrāvusies ar runas mākslu, erudīcijas spēlēm un vīnu pasauli. Beatei patīk izaicināt savu prātu un uzticēties intuīcijai, viens no viņas sapņiem ir reiz ierunāt kādu multfilmas vai pasaku tēlu. Leina Markevica - vienkārši brīvmāksliniece, viegli pierunājama spontāniem plāniem un piedzīvojumiem, aizraujas ar improvizāciju un komēdiju. Patīk radīt apkārtējiem patīkamu noskaņojumu, prot neapjukt neparedzētās situācijās pat tad, kad nekas nenotiek pēc plāna, tāpēc draugi uztic svarīgu pasākumu organizēšanu tieši viņai. Olafs Arnicāns - strādā tehnoloģiju nozarē, kur jaunu informāciju apgūst ātri un ar vieglumu, brīvajā laikā lasa un skatās dokumentālās filmas. Patiesu dvēseles piepildījumu Olafs rod, dodoties dabā vai aktīvi sportojot. Viņš zina labākās sēņu vietas, taču šo vērtīgo informāciju rūpīgi glabā. Mīl arī eksperimentēt virtuvē. Zane Vaļule - komandas kapteine. No Augšdaugavas novada, kur strādā par Latgales zooloģiskā dārza ekskursiju vadītāju. 22 gadus pavadījusi skolas un universitātes solos, bet nu izbauda dienas bez mājasdarbiem. Piecus mēnešus dzīvojusi Kanādā, vairāk nekā gadu - automašīnā Jaunzēlandē. Ļoti patīk pārvietoties kājām un laimēt loterijās. Aivis Vaļulis - kapteines brālis. Strādā meliorācijas nozarē Jelgavas pusē. Domā tik ātri, ka pats reizēm netiek līdzi savam domu gājienam. Ievērības cienīgs fakts - sešas reizes pieveicis pārgājienu Kolka–Dubulti. Televīzijas raidījumus neskatās, bet pats tajos reizēm piedalās. Liene Lubāne – no Jēkabpils, studējusi vides zinātnes, šobrīd strādā privātā uzņēmumā, kas gatavo bērnu rotaļu laukumus. Liene ir kapteines draudzene, brīvajā laikā strādā savā lauku saimniecībā, iet pārgājienos un izlīdz draugiem, kas iesprūduši vētras izraisītos postījumos un netiek uz "V.I.P." ierakstu, tā pati kļūstot no līdzjutējas par dalībnieci.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport must complete their mission to disrupt the activity of drug traffickers. First, they will detect an ingeniously hidden cocaine shipment with the help of specially trained dogs. Later, thanks to their X-ray equipment, they thwart the attempt of a man to smuggle cocaine capsules inside his stomach while they also rush to save his life. Immigrations officers live moments of dramatic tension when a mother tries to take her daughter out of the country with forged documents. Later, they must stop a passenger from evading justice by leaving the country. Meanwhile, the officers working at the post office will intercept a shipment of cocaine hidden inside an apparently innocent children's movie, and they will discover that a cargo of thirty handcrafted ceramic statuettes of Latin American political leaders might not be what it appears to be. In one of the security check-points, the infrared control system for luggage manages to catch an unexpected stash of ten kilograms of liquid cocaine, stored inside deodorant canisters. Later, the officers must sharpen their senses when the shoes of two passengers, pretending to be buddies on a holiday trip, might yield evidence that could land the two men in jail.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Officers from Colombian customs, immigration, and law enforcement agencies at El Dorado International Airport make sure national security is the top priority by cracking down on criminals attempting to smuggle illegal goods out of the country while also helping passengers in trouble. In this episode, a man is arrested after security agents find five kilograms of cocaine hidden in his suitcase. Astonished by the discovery, the passenger claims to be innocent and accuses his son in law of having tricked him. Two individuals posing as a couple of young tourists, turn out to be complete strangers carrying cocaine capsules inside their bodies. And then, officers unveil one of the boldest drugs smuggling attempt: a woman holding a cocaine "package" in her genital area. Meanwhile, immigration officers must prevent three passengers from flying to Sweden with forged passports, while trying to figure out their true identity and nationality. Later, drama and tension unfold as they carry an operation involving a charter flight with over 60 Colombians deported from the United States for different crimes.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Air and Marine Operations agents in Fajardo chase a vessel to a marina and suspects flee, leaving over 280 kilos of cocaine hidden inside. Mayaguez AMO agents provide armed transport for the USCG, transferring a murder suspect from sea to airfield. Later, they intercept a migrant vessel by shooting out its engine. Agents in the U.S. Virgin Island seize over $750k in cash from a smuggling vessel.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: When heroin users in America began turning up with raw lesions, decaying skin and grotesque sores on arms and legs, doctors were worried. The symptoms looked like those associated with Krokodil - a home-cooked, super-strong opiate that got its start in Siberian Russia. Made from codeine "cooked" with toxic ingredients, Krokodil can be stronger than heroin, and more addictive. But the DEA has yet to confirm the presence of Krokodil on US soil and suspected cases in Chicago and Niagara, NY, remain unproven. Heroin is cheap and widely available, so will US dealers and users go to the trouble and expense of sourcing codeine? Drugs Inc journeys to Georgia, Armenia and the Ukraine to meet Krokodil's users and dealers as they reveal the true horror of this home-made drug and, in the process, deliver a strong warning to America.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: A dealer makes a drop at a Hollywood red carpet event; a family hustles back packs of paste through the Peruvian forest; a US Customs plane tracks a light aircraft as it makes a belly landing in the dead of night in Guatemalan; a Border Patrol Agent sweats his way through a tiny tunnel under the US-Mexican border, tracing its route as oxygen levels drop dangerously low; a wholesaler prepares a five-kilo shipment. At every step the price goes up, and the risks grow greater. Drugs Inc reveals the international supply chain of a drug that starts life as a leaf and ends up as a powder more valuable than gold: cocaine.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: Thailand is in the grip of an addiction epidemic that is spinning out of control, as a candy-colored meth pill called yaba overtakes every other drug used in the country. Yaba in Thai means 'crazy medicine,' and heavy use of the pill can trigger psychosis. The death penalty hangs over every dealer, but that does not seem to deter them. Dealers find many ways to dodge the cops and customs authorities to keep the profits rolling in.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Growing to over 12 feet long and 1300 pounds, the prehistoric white sturgeon is a true freshwater giant, but because of human activity, its populations are now in decline. Cyril and his crew embark on a dangerous, action-packed mission to help scientists protect them. But to find this massive animal, the team must search the raging mountain rivers and dive beneath their frigid waters, all while avoiding bears, rock slides, freezing temperatures and deadly currents.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: An exhausting battle with a colossal white sturgeon pushes Cyril to the limit, but before the team can tag the eight-foot giant, it gives them a giant-sized shock. A freak wind storm then forces the team to put their white sturgeon quest on hold and head far north into the mountains to help protect the sturgeon's main food source: the pacific salmon. In order to find these migrating warrior fish, that can weigh up to 100 pounds, the guys will have to leave civilization behind and survive in one of the most hostile, rugged mountain environments in the world. Out here, hostile terrain, black bears and grizzly bears lurk around every corner.

programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.desc: For centuries treasure ships sailed the oceans of the world...packed with silver, gold and precious stones. Hunted by pirates. Battered by storms. Threatened by reefs and rocky shores. Around the world, countless treasures and wrecks remain unexplored. Now, new underwater scientific surveys explore the deep oceans, powerful computers turn data in to 3D images, and we can examine sunken treasures in detail from any angle. Draining the oceans throws new light on the richest wrecks in the world.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans: Deep Dive
programme.desc: Beneath the waters of the world, lies undersea empires and relics of their bloody wars. Through the use of cutting edge technology we will uncover lost empires? for the first time. Why did a Pharaoh build fifteen mega-forts and none of them saw a major battle? And how did Britain and Germany get locked into a dangerous arms race, spending billions on ever larger and more powerful battleships. These embattled seas gave rise to some of the greatest superpowers in history!

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: In northern Chile, 33 miners were buried more than half a mile deep in the desert with no way to escape. Across a terrifying first 17 days, the men must overcome impossible conditions to stay alive. As each passing day makes survival seem less likely, desperation sets in until an extraordinary discovery changes everything.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: Rescuers establish contact with the miners, sparking hope. Supplies make it underground, alleviating the terror of being trapped without food or water. As the world watches, the rescue team races to find a way through solid rock, but every possible solution brings new risks. Then, the ingenuity and determination of this unprecedented rescue effort are threatened by a devastating mechanical failure.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: The miners enter their second month underground, and the focus on the surface shifts to the seemingly impossible task of bringing all 33 men safely home. The rescue enters a critical phase as the miners prepare to enter a tiny capsule designed to transport them, one by one, through a treacherous borehole to the surface.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley delves into the complex identity of Italy's northernmost region, where many speak German as well as Italian. He samples an unexpectedly delicious hay soup, skis down a mountain to experience Dirndl Day, eats slope-side polenta, and fly-fishes in a glacial river. Along the way, he uncovers a history of border conflict, which has left its mark on the people and their food.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley exposes the pioneering spirit of Italy's industrial heartland, where the cuisine and ingredients are defiantly forward-thinking. He samples a futuristic menu made possible by a space-age farm, taste-tests new dishes at the country's famed service stations and discovers one of the world's most expensive ingredients being grown in the shadow of a steel factory.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Sally
programme.desc: Sally Ride became the first American woman to blast off into space, but beneath her unflappable composure, she carried a secret. Revealing the romance and sacrifices of their 27 years together, Sally's life partner, Tam O'Shaughnessy, tells the full story of this complicated and iconic astronaut for the first time. SALLY is directed by Emmy Award-winning filmmaker Cristina Costantini.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Officers from Colombian customs, immigration, and law enforcement agencies at El Dorado International Airport make sure national security is the top priority by cracking down on criminals attempting to smuggle illegal goods out of the country while also helping passengers in trouble. In this episode, a man is arrested after security agents find five kilograms of cocaine hidden in his suitcase. Astonished by the discovery, the passenger claims to be innocent and accuses his son in law of having tricked him. Two individuals posing as a couple of young tourists, turn out to be complete strangers carrying cocaine capsules inside their bodies. And then, officers unveil one of the boldest drugs smuggling attempt: a woman holding a cocaine "package" in her genital area. Meanwhile, immigration officers must prevent three passengers from flying to Sweden with forged passports, while trying to figure out their true identity and nationality. Later, drama and tension unfold as they carry an operation involving a charter flight with over 60 Colombians deported from the United States for different crimes.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, fight the most daring and unexpected attempts to smuggle drugs out of the country. Behind the apparent innocence of a young woman traveling with her stepmother, the officers stop one of the biggest drug smuggling attempts in years. Later, they won't believe their eyes when the X-ray machine reveals that a young man is wearing a cocaine-filled adult diaper. Immigration officers must contend with an out of control Cuban passenger to whom they are forced to deport. Later, tragedy unfolds when they must prevent a mother from traveling with her young daughter to Europe. A thrifty passenger manages to pass through all airport security check-points with two kilograms of cocaine hidden in his carry-on bag, but he will be cornered as the officers' well-trained sense of smell will trigger and make him a suspect. A passenger on her way to the Dominican Republic denies being the owner of a bag as it's about to be searched. The inspection will reveal something unexpected.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport must complete their mission to disrupt the activity of drug traffickers. First, they will detect an ingeniously hidden cocaine shipment with the help of specially trained dogs. Later, thanks to their X-ray equipment, they thwart the attempt of a man to smuggle cocaine capsules inside his stomach while they also rush to save his life. Immigrations officers live moments of dramatic tension when a mother tries to take her daughter out of the country with forged documents. Later, they must stop a passenger from evading justice by leaving the country. Meanwhile, the officers working at the post office will intercept a shipment of cocaine hidden inside an apparently innocent children's movie, and they will discover that a cargo of thirty handcrafted ceramic statuettes of Latin American political leaders might not be what it appears to be. In one of the security check-points, the infrared control system for luggage manages to catch an unexpected stash of ten kilograms of liquid cocaine, stored inside deodorant canisters. Later, the officers must sharpen their senses when the shoes of two passengers, pretending to be buddies on a holiday trip, might yield evidence that could land the two men in jail.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Enormous ancient terraces made of volcanic rocks in West Java, Indonesia, have origins shrouded in mystery. Hundreds of human skeletal remains unearthed on the island of St. Helena reveal a dark and sorrowful past. In the Persian gulf, a blood-red beach on Hormuz Island ignites wild speculation. Mysterious penguin remains are discovered in a place beyond the reach of these short-legged creatures.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Findings include a small volcanic island off coast of Edinburgh with a dark past; elaborate ancient Egyptian style burials on Sudan's Sai Island. A bronze device recovered from a long, lost shipwreck is actually an ancient analog computer. Scientists investigating the sudden disappearance of sharks around Californian islands reveal the interesting connection between orcas and great white sharks.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt, but close inspection reveals a consistent set of strange marks around all the hieroglyphs spelling Tutankhamun's name. Could the name have been engraved over top of another? In North America during World War II, strange and insidious-looking devices made of wood, rope, sandbags and gunpowder were found scattered across the northwestern USA and Canada. Who made them, and what was their sinister purpose? And in East London, a decorative clay bottle from the Middle Ages is uncovered. Not so strange, until the plug was removed and the bottle's contents revealed to include rusty nails, centuries-old human hair, fingernails … and urine. What is this sorcery?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Theyre falling out of the skies, clogging up rivers and spoiling shorelines around the planet. Why are we seeing mass animal die-offs around the world? Scientists are searching for answers, while also studying why some species are beginning to vanish. In the United States, shrinking populations of bees and bats worry researchers. Are these die-offs natural occurrences, signs of a planet in distress, or are they beyond explanation?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: The crew faces-off with a back-breaking, 200-pound giant in the deep waters of the Pacific Ocean, as they seek to help save the white sturgeon's favourite food; the mighty Pacific salmon. Their mission takes them far out to sea, and deeper into the rugged mountains than they've ever been before. To find these elusive warrior fish, they must brave massive waves, raft down treacherous, frigid rapids, and evade hunting grizzly bears.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Time is running out, and the team must return to the Fraser River to find and tag the 300-pound giant white sturgeon they are looking for. But first, they have to find their way out of the remote wilderness to deliver their salmon samples. Stranded by severe weather, they'll need to survive brutal rapids, rappel down terrifying cliffs, climb a massive glacier, and hike across rugged mountains if they want to succeed. And with a massive prehistoric fish finally on the line, the guys are in for a white-knuckled end to their northern mission.

From the construction of the world's largest ocean-going cruise liner, 'Icon of the Seas' in Finland to the ground-breaking Brenner Tunnel beneath the Alps on the Italy-Austria border, each episode highlights the skills, technology, and engineering brilliance that make these awe-inspiring builds possible.

programme.title: Superstructures: Mega Carriers
programme.desc: Venture inside the world's most giant-sized transporters. Watch a mega-sized cargo ship take a massive shipment across the world, soar to new heights on a giant airplane, and explore outer space on a super-sized space station. With the help of world-class engineers, architects and construction teams; experience game changing innovation layer by layer and everything that's hidden inside.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. An airliner is crippled after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the courageous captain pulls off an amphibious landing in the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure strikes high above the Canadian Prairies turning a Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. And, when the engines of TACA Flight 110 flame out in a violent storm, its captain pulls off one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Sometimes the trust between pilots and their planes breaks down, and the cockpit inadvertently becomes a struggle that pits man against machine. Eager crowds gather at an air show to watch the new pride of French aviation, but witness a fiery disaster instead. During a routine test flight, one of the world's most advanced planes nosedives into the Mediterranean. And, when a packed Airbus disappears over the Atlantic, investigators face a two-year deep-sea search for answers.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from "Homeland" — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The Hollywood ending: During one of the bloodiest periods of conflict in the Middle East, a CIA officer faces the ultimate test of trust. Recruiting a mole inside al-Qaida is only the beginning; the real challenge is keeping him alive. Intelligence alone won't win the battle. The true test lies in safeguarding the life of a man who holds the key to countless operations. As danger closes in from every direction, loyalty, strategy and courage collide in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Midyat, Turkey, archaeologists uncover the vast underground city of Matiate, stretching across tunnels and chambers carved thousands of years ago. Evidence of churches, synagogues and Roman coins suggests it was once a refuge for people fleeing religious persecution. In Royston, England, workmen stumble upon a mysterious chalk-carved chamber filled with intricate religious carvings. Beneath Orvieto, Italy, a wine cellar excavation reveals Cavità 254, a striking Etruscan subterranean complex. Once a quarry or water system, its deliberate infilling with pottery and bones hints at ritual or symbolic burial practices. Finally, in Abarkuh, Iran, archaeologists map a massive subterranean tunnel network. Likely part of an ancient qanat water system, exemplifying Persian ingenuity, it used engineering to survive drought, war and desert heat.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Poland, miners uncovered vast salt chambers known as the Crystal Caves, filled with massive halite crystals formed millions of years ago. Over centuries, this industrial mine evolved into a spiritual and cultural sanctuary. In England, a declassified Cold War relic known as the Burlington Bunker is revealed. Built in secret as a sprawling underground government headquarters, it could sustain people for months, but new evidence suggests it may also have served as a strategic decoy. In Egypt, archaeologists discovered a 3,400-year-old New Kingdom settlement buried beneath ruins, challenging assumptions about Egypt's western frontier. Finally, in China, the mysterious Longyou Caves baffle experts. Their precise engineering and unknown purpose make them one of the world's most enigmatic ancient constructions that still defy explanation.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1588, Robert Devereux, the Earl of Essex stood beside Elizabeth I as she rallied her troops to face the Spanish Armada. Young and charismatic, he was Elizabeth's intimate confidante, her favourite. But Essex's charm was matched by his recklessness. From arguing with the queen to leading a disastrous military campaign in Ireland, his behaviour pushed the limits of royal patience. Eventually, disgruntled and politically weakened, Essex launched a rebellion that would see him executed. Was he really out to seize the crown? Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden beneath seas, sands and stone, ancient medicine comes back into view. Off the coast of Italy, a Roman shipwreck preserves a sealed medical chest containing tablets and tinctures that mirror remedies still recognized today, including treatments for eye disease. In the Levant, poppy-shaped jars point to the world's earliest known use of opium, raising questions about healing, pain relief and post-mortem ritual. Far earlier, deep within the caves of Borneo, a 31,000-year-old skeleton bearing a carefully healed leg amputation reveals advanced anatomical knowledge, long-term care, and surgical planning once thought impossible in the Stone Age. Together, these discoveries uncover a medical sophistication far deeper — and far older — than once imagined.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden in coins, bones and ancient texts, the struggle to defeat disease spans continents and millennia. In England, hundreds of angel coins uncover a royal healing ritual once believed to cure the "king's evil" through the monarch's touch, revealing why kings risked contact with the sick. In India, a 4,000-year-old skull bearing unmistakable signs of leprosy offers rare insight into a disease that shaped human history and the lengths healers went to combat it. In Egypt, papyri filled with diagnoses and prescriptions combine with newly examined skeletal evidence to suggest one of the earliest known attempts to surgically treat cancer. Together, these discoveries reveal how belief, authority and experimentation shaped the earliest fights against humanity's most feared illnesses.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: John Dudley rose from family disgrace to become the power behind King Edward VI's rule. In a court divided into two powerful factions, religious reformers and conservative Catholic nobility, Dudley betrayed friendships and crushed rivals, making powerful enemies along the way. In 1553, when the young king died, rumours swirled that Dudley had conspired to snatch the crown for his daughter-in-law, Lady Jane Grey. She was abruptly dethroned by the future Mary I and, without supporters, Dudley was arrested and executed as a traitor. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Dudley's rise and downfall. They uncover how he navigated the shifting alliances of the Tudor court and re-examine the evidence that sealed his fate. For so long, Dudley was a winner in the Tudor game of thrones; ultimately, was he also its victim?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1588, Robert Devereux, the Earl of Essex stood beside Elizabeth I as she rallied her troops to face the Spanish Armada. Young and charismatic, he was Elizabeth's intimate confidante, her favourite. But Essex's charm was matched by his recklessness. From arguing with the queen to leading a disastrous military campaign in Ireland, his behaviour pushed the limits of royal patience. Eventually, disgruntled and politically weakened, Essex launched a rebellion that would see him executed. Was he really out to seize the crown? Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from "Homeland" — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The Hollywood ending: During one of the bloodiest periods of conflict in the Middle East, a CIA officer faces the ultimate test of trust. Recruiting a mole inside al-Qaida is only the beginning; the real challenge is keeping him alive. Intelligence alone won't win the battle. The true test lies in safeguarding the life of a man who holds the key to countless operations. As danger closes in from every direction, loyalty, strategy and courage collide in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. An airliner is crippled after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the courageous captain pulls off an amphibious landing in the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure strikes high above the Canadian Prairies turning a Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. And, when the engines of TACA Flight 110 flame out in a violent storm, its captain pulls off one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Sometimes the trust between pilots and their planes breaks down, and the cockpit inadvertently becomes a struggle that pits man against machine. Eager crowds gather at an air show to watch the new pride of French aviation, but witness a fiery disaster instead. During a routine test flight, one of the world's most advanced planes nosedives into the Mediterranean. And, when a packed Airbus disappears over the Atlantic, investigators face a two-year deep-sea search for answers.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Bill Nye is feeling down. The therapist listens sympathetically, and diagnoses the cause: Bill is suffering from grief: climate change grief. Thus begins the most unorthodox hour ever devoted to the subject of climate change. Bill Nye, scientist, mechanical engineer, comedian, actor, and Science Guy, will walk through the five stages of climate change grief and, along the way, teach us what's gone wrong with our planet and how we can start to turn things around.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: For more than 2000 years she's been revered as the Blessed Virgin, the Queen of Peace, and the Mother of God...but faith is not found in ancient scripture, it's a living experience. To truly understand the Virgin Mary, we must understand the millions of believers who are devoted to her. What we are about to discover is a complex world of spiritual passion, obsession, and corruption. This is a film that will explore the conflict between mystical experience and organized religion, the dangers of believing in false prophets, and the primal human need to connect with a divine mother figure. The episode follows a mother of three with terminal cancer as she makes her first pilgrimage to the miraculous village of Medjugorje, Bosnia-Herzegovina; where six schoolchildren claimed to see the Virgin Mary in 1981. Some of these visionaries still see her to this day. A million pilgrims make the journey here every year, yet the Vatican has not given the site its official sanction. No Marian site in the world is more popular - or controversial. We also meet Terry Colafrancesco, who founded Caritas of Birminham after one of the Medjugorje visionaries visited him in Alabama. A self-contained religious community,Caritas is dedicated to spreading the messages of Our Lady of Medjugorje. Yet, Cartias reveals a more complicated and perhaps darker side to Marian devotion.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsey sets out on a journey to some of the worlds most remote locations, where he'll be looking for an adventure of the culinary kind. Basking in the culture of each setting he ends up, his cooking has never been more inspired than when on such an adventure. Whether he's cooking at altitude in Peru or educating himself on Alaskan cuisine, Gordon is experiencing the world like never before and beautifully curating a delicious morsel for each setting. It's a far cry from the professional kitchen he's used to and he's handling ingredients that are completely new, but the food doesn't get better than this.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay journeys to some of the most incredible and remote locations on Earth in search of culinary inspiration, epic adventures and cultural experiences he will never forget. In the final episode of the series, he heads to the Alaskan Panhandle to explore the region and the cuisine. He's taught how to cook seal with a native Tlingit elder, scales a rock face in a treacherous snowstorm, and hunts grouse. He then prepares a feast with the local chef Lionel Uddipa.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve.
